content.short: Adappt is a next-generation Web3 AppStore and GameFi hub built on the DERWA framework for seamless project onboarding.
content.description: Adappt is a next-generation Web3 AppStore and GameFi hub built on the Digital Entertainment Real-World Asset (DERWA) framework, facilitating rapid Web2-to-Web3 transitions. It provides developers with tools to onboard traditional projects in just three days, enabling true tokenized ownership of digital assets. The platform features an integrated incentive system, including NFT mining pools, token airdrops, and mission-based rewards to drive user engagement. By hosting seasonal competitions and quests, Adappt creates a vibrant ecosystem for global gaming communities and decentralized developers.
